== Summary ==
Change crop (after) for [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)|I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Errata)]]: the region (108, 780, 724, 1036) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)|I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/74a6bd4970fefd8f67cc9f58497e2d5a2545f6ee/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif Holotable commit 74a6bd4] (2023-12-21). The matching before crop is [[:File:V21-L-icantbelievehesgone-2023-12-21-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the image of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b8af2d419a63b6a0edcf32c2b298935e403013c3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif commit b8af2d4]) and [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)|I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Errata)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/74a6bd4970fefd8f67cc9f58497e2d5a2545f6ee/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif commit 74a6bd4]).
